## Start here

#### ★★★ Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms

Roy Featherstone · 2008 · *Springer* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Rigid%20Body%20Dynamics%20Algorithms%22)

- **Why:** The definitive text on RNEA, CRBA, ABA and contact.
- **Read:** Ch. 2, 4–7, 8 and 11.

#### ★☆☆ Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control

Lynch & Park · 2017 · *Cambridge University Press (free PDF)* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Modern%20Robotics%3A%20Mechanics%2C%20Planning%2C%20and%20Control%22)

- **Why:** The notation this Mark uses.
- **Read:** Ch. 3, 4, 5 and 8.

#### ★★☆ A micro Lie theory for state estimation in robotics

Solà, Deray & Atchuthan · 2018 · *arXiv:1812.01537* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20micro%20Lie%20theory%20for%20state%20estimation%20in%20robotics%22)

- **Why:** Lie theory for roboticists in 30 pages.
- **Read:** §I–IV and the appendices on SO(3)/SE(3).
